definitions.gloss: love at first sight; falling in love at first glance
definitions.explanation: The experience of immediately falling in love with someone (or occasionally something) upon seeing them for the first time.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}に{一目惚|ひとめぼ}れした。
examples.english: I fell in love with her at first sight.

examples.japanese: それは{一目惚|ひとめぼ}れだったと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think it was love at first sight.

examples.japanese: このバッグに{一目惚|ひとめぼ}れして、つい{買|か}ってしまった。
examples.english: I fell in love with this bag at first sight and ended up buying it.

notes:
USAGE:
Used with する to form a verb: {一目惚|ひとめぼ}れする. Can be used for people (romantic) or things (an item you instantly want). The particle に marks the object of attraction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一目惚|ひとめぼ}れする (to fall in love at first sight)
- 〜に{一目惚|ひとめぼ}れした (fell in love with ~ at first sight)
- {一目惚|ひとめぼ}れだった (it was love at first sight)

WORD FORMATION:
{一目|ひとめ} (one glance) + {惚|ほ}れ (falling in love). {惚|ほ}れる is a verb meaning "to fall in love."
